name: Browser Use
description: Inspect and operate websites directly in the owner’s connected browser, including tabs, forms, collections, and authenticated file downloads. Prefer this toolkit for browser tasks.
progressive_guidance: Use direct browser inspection first for website tasks. Continue in the relevant existing tab and preserve the owner’s chosen browser. Use computer_use for browser chrome and native OS dialogs such as file pickers, then return here for page work. If browser access requires owner permission or setup, pause and explain the required owner action; do not switch browsers or use Cua as a workaround. Before processing a collection, establish its scope and source identities through pagination or scrolling; a current DOM snapshot does not prove that the full collection has been enumerated. Keep progress and remaining work in the shared task plan.
